== Published English Original Virtual Set 8 wording ==
The remaster names your deploy phase for the weapon action and regular move. It drops activation and the printed free adjacent relocation alternative. The Tusken connection and +2 weapon destiny remain. The sheets differ in capitalization of the same card name.
